quote: Exceptional dentistry begins with listening. The plan is built around your goals and your bite, not a catalogue.

focus.d: Facial, gingival and dental proportions analysed first. Veneer workflows from diagnosis to final delivery, with minimally invasive preparation.
Adhesive protocols trained with Dr. Pascal Magne: composite veneers, inlays and onlays, and posterior restorations that preserve enamel.
Invisalign Gold Provider. Orthodontics integrated into smile design cases, with digital diagnosis, planning and smile visualization.
Kois-trained treatment planning and functional occlusion: implant restorations, fixed and removable prosthodontics and endodontics.

education.i: Rutgers School of Dental Medicine, Newark. ICOI Pre-Doctoral Student Achievement Award
Dr. John Kois, Seattle: restorative-periodontal interface, functional occlusion, implant restorations, biomechanics and advanced treatment planning
Dr. Pascal Magne, Los Angeles: the ultimate veneer, advanced composite veneers, inlays and onlays, morphology and esthetics
Rosenthal Institute, NYU College of Dentistry
